what: On hover, a 60° gradient plate of two accent colors switches on behind the cell in .3s and, starting .2s later, spins endlessly one turn every 4 seconds. Each time the pointer enters or leaves, the pattern turns another 60° (1.2s). Cell text uses the on-accent color

options.kick: Extra rotation angle of the pattern on enter and exit, default 60
options.look: If always, the panel stays on at all times (Contact button)

use: → — Panel (data-fx-part="spin") is created and attached if missing

from.where: shared.js .hz-gradient (arrow slot and button icon — only with interaction, headband and footer contact — look: always)
